about_the_game:
Joseph is a computer science major spiraling through a deeply personal and psychologically unfiltered experience. After his politically unhinged online girlfriend, Jessica, unexpectedly goes AFK in the middle of a degrading text-based ERP, he’s left alone—with nothing but his thoughts, paranoia, and the silence that exacerbates it all.

Taking his therapist’s advice to “journal,” Joseph begins recording his inner monologue while supposedly under the influence of fictionalized "drugs." What follows is a descent into distorted perception, where fantasy and reality merge. His relationship anxieties, traumas with women, repressed thoughts, and imagined waifus begin to manifest in surreal, decaying ways.

AFK GF is a visual novel with a dark satirical tone, blending social commentary, psychological horror, and meta storytelling. Embrace the absurd, the uncomfortable, and the deeply personal as you step into the fragmented mind of a broken man trying to make sense of his deteriorating life.

Features:

  • A chatroom-inspired UI that evolves with the story

  • Introspective monologues, surreal cutscenes, and unreliable narration

  • Branching dialogue and multiple endings based on player choices

  • ARG elements hidden throughout, rewarding deep observation and interaction

  • A blend of dark humor, emotional vulnerability, and existential dread

  • Archives of older comics, stories, music, and more from yours truly

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains strong language, mature themes, and intense emotional content. Players should be aware that the narrative includes fictional depictions of toxic relationships, self-destructive behavior, emotional abuse, and psychological distress.

There are references to non-consensual acts, self-harm, and drug use presented through a stylized and surreal lens. These are portrayed as part of the story's exploration of unhealthy dynamics, trauma, and isolation, these are deconstructive and critical, and they are not endorsements or glorifications of the subject matter at hand.

Player discretion is advised. This game is not intended for children or sensitive audiences.
